evidence.evidence_effect: Supports exclusivity for the specified product, Ontario territory, and municipal-utility customers, but contradicts the claim of exclusivity throughout Canada for all customers.

evidence.evidence_effect: Contradicts the claimed website and retail-store channels.

claim_text: The Distributor has exclusive rights throughout Canada to sell AquaMesh replacement filtration cartridges through its website and retail stores to all customers, and may freely sublicense those rights.

restrictions.restriction_description: The exclusive grant is limited to Ontario and municipal water utilities; Licensor retains rights outside that scope.
Retail-store sales and all e-commerce sales are prohibited; trade distributors require written approval.
restrictions.applicable_scope: Sales of AquaMesh replacement filtration cartridges in the licensed territory

restrictions.restriction_description: Subdistributors may be appointed only with Licensor's prior written consent and remain subject to the stated limits.

contract_text:
Distribution License Agreement
1.1 Licensor grants Distributor an exclusive right to market and sell AquaMesh replacement filtration cartridges in Ontario, Canada, solely to municipal water utilities.
1.2 Sales are limited to direct account sales and trade distributors approved in writing by Licensor. Retail-store sales and all e-commerce sales are prohibited.
1.3 Distributor may appoint subdistributors only with Licensor's prior written consent. Any approved appointment remains subject to the product, territory, and customer limits in Section 1.1.
1.4 Licensor retains the right to appoint other distributors and to sell the products outside the territory and customer scope stated in Section 1.1.

sales_channels: Trade distributors approved in writing by Licensor

verification_rationale: The agreement grants an exclusive right for the named cartridges, but only in Ontario and only for municipal water utilities. It prohibits e-commerce and retail-store sales, and subdistributors require prior written consent. The claim therefore overstates the territory, customer scope, permitted channels, and sublicensing rights.
